t2.title: Exams be replaced with other forms of assessment
t2.prompt: A student magazine announced an article writing contest. The best ones will be published in the magazine. Write your article on this topic: "Should exams be replaced with other forms of assessment?" Write 180–200 words, giving reasons and examples.
t2.sample:
Traditional examinations have been the primary method of assessment for centuries, but many argue they should be replaced with alternative approaches. I partially agree with this view.

Exams have significant drawbacks. They create immense stress and anxiety that can prevent students from demonstrating their true abilities. Additionally, exams often test memorization rather than genuine understanding or practical skills. A student might pass an exam but struggle to apply knowledge in real-world situations.

Alternative assessments offer advantages. Coursework and projects allow students to demonstrate skills over time without intense pressure. Presentations develop communication abilities, while group work teaches collaboration. These methods assess a broader range of competencies relevant to modern workplaces.

However, completely eliminating exams would be problematic. Some subjects require testing factual knowledge, and exams ensure all students are assessed under identical conditions. They also prepare young people for competitive situations they will face in careers.

In conclusion, the best approach combines traditional exams with alternative assessments. This balanced system evaluates different abilities fairly while reducing excessive stress on students.

t2.sampleB2:
Should exams be a thing of the past?

Every year, millions of students spend sleepless nights cramming for exams. But are these tests really the best way to measure what we know? Many people believe the time has come to rethink how we assess learning, and whether exams still deserve their place in modern education.

There is no denying that exams have their flaws. They put students under enormous pressure, and a single bad day can ruin months of hard work. What's more, they often reward memorisation rather than real understanding.

On the other hand, alternatives such as coursework, projects and presentations allow learners to show their skills over time. These methods reflect the kind of tasks we face in the real world, from meeting deadlines to working in teams.

That said, exams are not without their merits. They are fair, since everyone sits the same paper under the same conditions, and they prepare us for high-pressure situations later in life.

In my opinion, the answer lies somewhere in between. Rather than scrapping exams altogether, schools should strike a balance, combining traditional tests with more practical forms of assessment. That way, we get the best of both worlds and everyone wins.
t2.uzSample:
An’anaviy imtihonlar asrlar davomida baholashning asosiy usuli bo‘lib kelgan, ammo ko‘pchilik ularni muqobil yondashuvlar bilan almashtirish kerak deb hisoblaydi. Men bu fikrga qisman qo‘shilaman.

Imtihonlarning sezilarli kamchiliklari bor. Ular talabalarning haqiqiy qobiliyatlarini namoyish etishiga to‘sqinlik qiladigan juda katta stress va xavotirni keltirib chiqaradi. Bundan tashqari, imtihonlar ko'pincha haqiqiy tushunish yoki amaliy ko'nikmalardan ko'ra yodlashni tekshiradi. Talaba imtihondan o'tishi mumkin, ammo bilimni real hayotiy vaziyatlarda qo'llashda qiynalishi mumkin.

Muqobil baholash usullari afzalliklarni taklif etadi. Kurs ishlari va loyihalar talabalarga qisqa muddatli kuchli bosimsiz, vaqt o'tishi bilan ko'nikmalarni namoyish etishga imkon beradi. Taqdimotlar kommunikatsiya qobiliyatlarini rivojlantiradi, guruhli ish esa hamkorlikni o'rgatadi. Ushbu usullar zamonaviy ish joylariga tegishli bo'lgan kengroq kompetensiyalarni baholaydi.

Biroq, imtihonlarni butunlay yo'q qilish muammoli bo'ladi. Ba'zi fanlar faktik bilimlarni sinovdan o'tkazishni talab qiladi va imtihonlar barcha talabalarning bir xil sharoitlarda baholanishini ta'minlaydi. Ular, shuningdek, yoshlarni kelajakdagi faoliyatida duch keladigan raqobatbardosh vaziyatlarga tayyorlaydi.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, eng yaxshi yondashuv an'anaviy imtihonlarni muqobil baholash usullari bilan birlashtiradi. Ushbu muvozanatli tizim talabalarga haddan tashqari stressni kamaytirgan holda, turli qobiliyatlarni adolatli baholaydi.

t2.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli Taste Academy jamoasi,

Men yaqinda bo'lib o'tgan italyan oshxonasi bo'yicha mahorat darsiga oid fikr-mulohazalarimni bildirish uchun yozyapman. Umuman olganda, bu tajriba juda ijobiy bo'ldi, garchi potentsial takomillashtirish uchun bir nechta sohalar mavjud.

Instruktor bilimli va qiziqarli bo'lib, xotirjam va qo'llab-quvvatlovchi o'quv muhitini yaratdi. O'qitish uslubi samarali bo'lib, namoyishlarni amaliy mashg'ulotlar bilan uyg'unlashtirdi. Mahsulotlarning sifati odatda yuqori edi va taqdim etilgan uskunalar yetarli edi, garchi bir nechta qo'shimcha ish joylari ba'zi bosqichlarda tirbandlikni kamaytirishi mumkin edi.

Kelajakdagi darslarga kelsak, men ayniqsa ilg'or pishirish usullarini, xususan, xamirturushsiz non tayyorlashni o'rganishga qiziqardim. Bundan tashqari, mintaqaviy hind oshxonasiga, ayniqsa vegetarian taomlariga qaratilgan kurs sizning o'quv dasturingizga yaxshi qo'shimcha bo'ladi. Shuningdek, men pichoqdan foydalanish mahoratiga bag'ishlangan dars ko'plab ishtirokchilar uchun juda foydali bo'ladi deb o'ylayman.

Fikrlarimni baham ko'rish imkoniyati uchun rahmat. Taste Academy-da kelajakdagi kurslarda qatnashishni intiqlik bilan kutaman.

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the cooking school. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample: Dear Taste Academy Team, Thank you for your email requesting feedback about the Italian cooking masterclass I attended last weekend. I thoroughly enjoyed the experience. Chef Marco was an excellent instructor who explained techniques clearly while sharing entertaining stories about Italian cuisine. The hands-on approach was particularly valuable, and I've already recreated the pasta dish at home successfully. The quality of ingredients provided was impressive, and having professional equipment to use made the experience authentic. However, I would suggest providing recipe cards with both metric and imperial measurements, as some participants found conversions confusing. I would love to see Asian cuisine classes added to your programme, particularly Thai and Japanese cooking. Please also consider offering multi-week courses for those wanting to develop skills progressively. I will definitely attend more classes. Yours sincerely, Javohir Ergashev
t12.sampleA1:
Hi Taste Academy,


I like the class. It was good. The chef is nice. The food is yummy. I want more pizza class.


Bye
t12.sampleA2:
Dear Taste Academy,


Thank you for the cooking class. I liked it very much. The teacher was good and the food was very nice. I made pasta. It was fun. But the room was hot, and the knives were not very sharp. I want to learn about cakes next time, because I like cakes very much.


Thank you.


From, Javohir Ergashev
t12.sampleB1:
Dear Taste Academy Team,


Thank you for the email. I am writing to give you some feedback about the Italian cooking class. I thought the class was good. The instructor was very helpful and friendly. I learned a lot about making pasta. The ingredients were also good quality, but some of the equipment was a bit old. For example, one of the pans was a bit rusty.


I think it would be good if you offered classes on other types of food. I am interested in learning about Spanish food, like paella. Also, maybe you could have a class just for desserts. I would like that.


Thank you again.


Sincerely,
Javohir Ergashev
t12.sampleB2:
Dear Taste Academy Team,

Thank you for your email inviting me to share my thoughts on the Italian Cooking Masterclass I attended last weekend.

I am pleased to say that I thoroughly enjoyed the session. The instructor was both knowledgeable and approachable, and the hands-on teaching style made it easy to pick up new techniques. The ingredients were fresh and of a high standard, and the equipment was well maintained throughout.

If I may offer one suggestion, it would be helpful to have printed recipe cards to take home, as I struggled to jot everything down in time.

Looking ahead, I would be keen to see classes on Asian cuisine, particularly Thai and Japanese cooking, as well as a course on essential knife skills.

Thank you once again for a wonderful experience.

Yours faithfully,
Dilnoza Karimova
